@[reducible] def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.L : Type :=
FreeLieAlgebra ℚ Bool
@[reducible] def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidFree : Type :=
FreeLieAlgebra ℚ OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Edge
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.chord : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidFree :=
fun i j =>
  if h : i < j then FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ ⟨(i, j), h⟩ else if h : j < i then FreeLieAlgebra.of ℚ ⟨(j, i), h⟩ else 0
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval.{u_1} : {M : Type u_1} →
  [inst : LieRing M] → [inst_1 : LieAlgebra ℚ M] → M → M → OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.L →ₗ⁅ℚ⁆ M :=
fun {M} [LieRing M] [LieAlgebra ℚ M] a b => (FreeLieAlgebra.lift ℚ) fun i => if i = Bool.true then b else a
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.IsSolution : OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.L → Prop :=
fun p =>
  p + (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.y OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.x) p = 0 ∧
    p + (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.y (-OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.x - OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.y)) p +
          (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval (-OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.x - OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.y) OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.x) p =
        0 ∧
      (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 0 1) (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 1 2 + OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 1 3)) p +
          (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 0 2 + OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 1 2) (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 2 3))
            p =
        (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 1 2) (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 2 3)) p +
            (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 0 1 + OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 0 2)
                (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 1 3 + OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 2 3))
              p +
          (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.eval (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 0 1) (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t 1 2)) p
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.W : Submodule ℚ OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.L :=
{ carrier := {p | OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.IsSolution p}, add_mem' := @OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.W._proof_2,
  zero_mem' := OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.W._proof_3, smul_mem' := OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.W._proof_4 }
@[reducible] def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Wn : ℕ → Submodule ℚ OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.L :=
fun n => OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.W ⊓ OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Ln n
@[reducible] def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Ln : ℕ → Submodule ℚ (FreeLieAlgebra ℚ Bool) :=
fun n => OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.weightPiece (fun x => 1) n
@[reducible] def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.Fn : ℕ → Submodule ℚ (FreeLieAlgebra ℚ ℕ) :=
fun n => OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.weightPiece OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.oddWeight n
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.oddWeight : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun k => 2 * k + 3
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.weightPiece.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → (α → ℕ) → ℕ → Submodule ℚ (FreeLieAlgebra ℚ α) :=
fun {α} wt n => Submodule.span ℚ {p | OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedWord wt n p}
inductive OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedWord.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → (α → ℕ) → ℕ → FreeLieAlgebra ℚ α → Prop

OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedWord.bracket : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {wt : α → ℕ} {n m : ℕ} {a b : FreeLieAlgebra ℚ α},
  OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedWord wt n a →
    OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedWord wt m b → OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.WeightedWord wt (n + m) ⁅a, b⁆
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.braidRelations : Set OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidFree :=
{z |
  (∃ i j k l,
      i ≠ j ∧
        i ≠ k ∧ i ≠ l ∧ j ≠ k ∧ j ≠ l ∧ k ≠ l ∧ z = ⁅OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.chord i j, OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.chord k l⁆) ∨
    ∃ i j k,
      i ≠ j ∧
        i ≠ k ∧
          j ≠ k ∧ z = ⁅OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.chord i j, OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.chord i k + OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.chord j k⁆}
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.braidIdeal : LieIdeal ℚ OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidFree :=
LieSubmodule.lieSpan ℚ OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidFree OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.braidRelations
@[reducible] def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.T4 : Type :=
OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.BraidFree ⧸ OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.braidIdeal
def OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.t : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.T4 :=
fun i j => LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk (OAI.DeligneDrinfeld.chord i j)
